event_summary: A small orange rounded piece on a vertical metal tool sits between two metal jaws while bright streaks appear and the orange piece becomes larger and brighter.
raw_event_description: The view starts tightly framed on two opposing metal faces with a narrow central gap and a vertical metal tool rising from below. A small orange rounded piece is centered at the tool tip near the lower edges of the metal faces. Thin bright streaks intermittently appear around the contact area, mostly shooting outward and downward to the sides. Over time the orange piece changes from a narrow capsule-like shape into a wider, brighter yellow-orange rounded mass around the top of the tool, while the surrounding metal faces remain in nearly the same visible position.

reasons: The main objects are visible but the first frame is soft-focused.
The orange piece is partly bordered or occluded by the upper metal faces.
The lower tool is visible but blurred in the foreground.
